Inspectable verification bundle live · recorded public evidence — Author: Blayne Aina (Denver, CO), USMC Veteran, Principal Systems Architect & Creator of AINA

AI can propose. It cannot act.

AINA (Autonomous Intelligent Networked Architecture) compiles probabilistic AI output into bounded proposals, checks authority, provenance, and leases at the commit boundary (core runtime in Rust, TypeScript minimal glue), and proves when protected state remains untouched. Trust is not a prompt. It is a boundary. Published solely for independent technical peer review, security/formal-verification critique, and AI-safety / federal R&D due diligence (not job-seeking).

1. Purpose, Canonical Definition & Diligence Scope (Zero Job-Seeking · Rust Core / TS Glue)

Who I am & why public: Blayne Aina — Principal Systems & Data Integrations Architect (11+ yrs enterprise CRM/ETL migrations & production cutovers, U.S. Marine Corps Veteran). Over 14 months of independent R&D (Aug 2025–Oct 2026) directing a 9-IDE AI fleet, I built AINA (Autonomous Intelligent Networked Architecture: deterministic execution-governance runtime squad.exe + verification standard) so systems engineers, formal-verification/security researchers, and R&D funding evaluators can audit the claims offline or in live walkthroughs. 4 Scope & Diligence Answers: (1) Windows NT first (CreateProcessW(CREATE_SUSPENDED), PssCaptureSnapshot, FILE_SHARE_READ, LPAC) proves real kernel confinement on one unforgiving substrate before scoping the Linux Rocky/RHEL 9 port under PRJ-NAVY-01 (clone3/pidfd_open pre-exec sync barrier + /proc/<pid>/fd, /proc/<pid>/maps & sealed memfd + Landlock/seccomp-bpf/fexecve); (2) Private runtime vs. public verifier: proprietary Rust source & squad.exe stay private to protect 3 filed USPTO provisionals, while 12 closed schemas, 4 receipts & proof/verify_refusal_proof.py run offline in 10s (live binary walked through under peer review/NDA; TypeScript is minimal glue); (3) 1-commit GitHub (github.com/SquadForge/blayne.aina) is a v1.0 release snapshot backed by private 14-month logs; (4) 45 conformance vs. 47 faults (§03): 45 binary end-to-end cases test compound gates while all 47 EISA fault classes are enforced at crate unit level.

2. Enterprise Track Record (2015–2026) & Four Core Failure Gaps Bound Atomically

2025–2026 (14 Mos) · AINA Architecture (Unfunded Solo · 9-IDE AI Fleet): Principal Systems Architect — Rust deterministic execution-governance runtime (squad.exe), 45/45 binary conformance gate, public SHA-256 refusal verifier. 2022–2025 · Agile Education Marketing: Enterprise CRM & Integration Architect — HubSpot/Salesforce integration boundaries, automated identity deduplication, hardened ETL pipelines. 2019–2022 · DrayMaster Enterprise: Lead Systems & Data Migration Architect — production migration & rate-engine cutovers across 7 business entities and 800+ freight carriers. Selected Advisory · Photector: Workflow & state-machine advisor — deterministic transitions & automated photographic intake validation. 2015–2018 · Jacuzzi Colorado: Multi-location Systems & Operations Lead — 6-location infrastructure cutover, 15,000+ SKU POS/ERP sync, operator readiness.

Why Existing IAM, Workflows, ACID & Guardrails Aren't Enough — 4 Failure Gaps Bound Atomically: (1) Provenance-to-Mutation Binding (§02+§03): RBAC allows authorized hallucinated writes; AINA requires server-cut srv_/ev_ byte-offset receipts verified via RFC 8785 JCS before admission. (2) Approval-to-Execution Pinning (§07): HITL approvals suffer spawn TOCTOU; AINA spawns via CreateProcessW(CREATE_SUSPENDED) and audits live PEB & handles (PssCaptureSnapshot) against pinned RequestedAct hash before ResumeThread. (3) OS-Enforced Stale-Worker Fencing (§04+§05): TTL locks let stalled agents overwrite state; AINA pairs monotonic Room lease generations with kernel FILE_SHARE_READ (ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION) and SQLite row_version checks at commit. (4) Non-Destructive Forensic Rollback (§06): SQL rollback erases evidence; Dual-Tier Vaults keep protected baselines untouched while shunting rejected/out-of-band mutations into immutable Amber Quarantine.

3. Three-Layer TCB Enforcement, Seven Closed Opcodes, Tiers 1–4, 8 Primitives, 5 Formal Q&As & 3 USPTO Provisionals

Three Enforcement Layers & TCB Bounds (§03): Layer 1 Pre-Parse (§03.1): MAX_SUBMISSION_BYTES = 1,048,576 (1 MiB), MAX_REQUESTED_ACT_BYTES = 65,536, MAX_EVIDENCE_REF_BYTES = 4,096, MAX_ACTS = 256 (1..256), single-stage homogeneity (Fracture vs. Forge), duplicate JSON key rejection (visit_map), non-finite float rejection (visit_f64), trailing matter rejection. Layer 2 Draft-07 Schema (all 12 schemas in proof/schemas/, recursive additionalProperties: false): squad.eisa.act_envelope.v1.json defines the 7 closed opcodes (BindEvidenceTag, RequestHumanReview, RejectUnlawfulAct, AssertLayoutRelation, AssertDuplicatePair, AssertTransitiveClosure, ProposePartition) with allOf stage-to-operand closure; integer-only confidence (0..10000 bps, zero floats); 15 non-inferential tags; 47 fault codes; RFC 6901 pointer MAX_POINTER_DEPTH = 8 (regex ^(?:/(?:[^/~\u0000-\u001f]|~[01])*){1,8}$) & MAX_POINTER_BYTES = 256; MAX_REASON_CHARS = 1,024; MAX_ID_CHARS = 64; MAX_REFS = 16; MAX_LIST = 1,000; MAX_CHAIN = 4 (18/18 pos & 26/26 neg schema/pre-parse tests). Layer 3 Runtime Four-Gate Machine & NT Kernel Confinement (§03.4–03.5): MAX_CASE_BYTES = 4,194,304 (4 MiB), MAX_CASE_RECORDS = 1,000, MAX_VALUE_CHARS = 1,024, MIN_PHONE_DIGITS = 7; downward Layer 0 → 3 acyclic DAG; submission-complete counterevidence check (counterevidence_suppressed); simple-path graph walk; Disjoint-Set Union-Find partition cover; CreateProcessW(CREATE_SUSPENDED) + PssCaptureSnapshot (act-pin), FILE_SHARE_READ exclusion, SQLite row-version checks (45/45 conformance, 20/20 evidence, 4 PCNA receipts).
